iterations.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_UniversityEnrollment" targetNamespace="http://example.org/university-enrollment">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_UniversityEnrollment" name="University Enrollment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Student" name="Student">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Applicant</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideMissingItems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmEnrollment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_StudyPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Semester_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AttendClasses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddDrop_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddDropCourses</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddDrop_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewGrades</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Grievance_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Grievance_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Continue_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_GraduatedOrWithdrawn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Admissions" name="Admissions Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Review_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DocsComplete_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMissing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Parallel_Split_Eval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Parallel_Join_Eval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAcceptance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRejection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ConfirmDeadline_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CancelApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Canceled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AdmissionsCommittee" name="Admissions Committee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Accepted_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Finance Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessFees</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetupAccounts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_InternationalOffice" name="International Student Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_International_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VisaProcessing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_International_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AppealsCommittee" name="Appeals Committee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Appeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_University" name="University">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Onboard_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendOrientation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Onboard_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueStudentID</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostGrades</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Applicant" name="Application submission needed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit application online"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Review_Merge" name="Application ready for review"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewApplication" name="Review application and supporting documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocsComplete_Split" name="Documents missing?" default="Flow_DocsComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyMissing" name="Notify applicant of missing documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideMissingItems" name="Provide missing items"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Split_Eval" name="Start evaluation and fee processing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateApplication" name="Evaluate application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessFees" name="Process application fees or waivers"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Join_Eval" name="Evaluation and fees complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Accepted_Split" name="Application accepted?" default="Flow_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Send acceptance letter"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send rejection letter"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Application rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" name="Confirm enrollment by deadline"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ConfirmDeadline_Split" name="Enrollment confirmed by deadline?" default="Flow_NotConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CancelApplication" name="Cancel application"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Canceled" name="Application canceled"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Onboard_Split" name="Start onboarding"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendOrientation" name="Provide orientation materials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetupAccounts" name="Set up email, online portal and library accounts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Onboard_Join" name="Onboarding complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_International_Split" name="International student?" default="Flow_Domestic"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VisaProcessing" name="Assist with visa processing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_International_Merge" name="Visa step done or not required"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueStudentID" name="Issue student ID card"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StudyPlan" name="Create study plan">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StudyPlan"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_MeetAdvisor" name="Meet with academic advisor"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCourses" name="Select courses"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ResolveConflicts" name="Resolve schedule conflicts"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StudyPlan"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP1" sourceRef="StartEvent_StudyPlan" targetRef="Task_MeetAdvisor"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP2" sourceRef="Task_MeetAdvisor" targetRef="Task_SelectCourses"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP3" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourses" targetRef="Task_ResolveConflicts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP4" sourceRef="Task_ResolveConflicts" targetRef="EndEvent_StudyPlan"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Semester_Merge" name="Start of semester"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AttendClasses" name="Attend classes"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDrop_Split" name="Add or drop courses in add/drop period?" default="Flow_NoAddDrop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddDropCourses" name="Add or drop courses"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddDrop_Merge" name="Add/drop handled"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostGrades" name="Post grades at end of semester"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewGrades" name="Review grades online"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Grievance_Split" name="Grievance to file?" default="Flow_NoGrievance"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Appeal" name="File appeal">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Appeal"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitAppealForm" name="Submit appeal form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" name="Meet with appeals committee"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" name="Await decision"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Appeal"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Appeal" targetRef="Task_SubmitAppealForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAppealForm" targetRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP3" sourceRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" targetRef="Task_AwaitAppealDecision"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AP4" sourceRef="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Appeal"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Grievance_Merge" name="Grievance step done or not needed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Continue_Split" name="Graduated or withdrawn?" default="Flow_ContinueSemester"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_GraduatedOrWithdrawn" name="Graduated or withdrawn"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Applicant" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Review_Merge" targetRef="Task_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReviewApplication" targetRef="Gateway_DocsComplete_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Missing" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsComplete_Split" targetRef="Task_NotifyMissing">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${documentsMissing}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocsComplete" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsComplete_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split_Eval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMissing" targetRef="Task_ProvideMissingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMissingItems" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split_Eval" targetRef="Task_EvaluateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split_Eval" targetRef="Task_ProcessFees"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join_Eval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFees" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join_Eval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join_Eval" targetRef="Gateway_Accepted_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_Accepted_Split" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${applicationAccepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_Accepted_Split" targetRef="Task_SendRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" targetRef="Gateway_ConfirmDeadline_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmed" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmDeadline_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Onboard_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enrollmentConfirmed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotConfirmed" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmDeadline_Split" targetRef="Task_CancelApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_CancelApplication" targetRef="EndEvent_Canceled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_Onboard_Split" targetRef="Task_SendOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_Onboard_Split" targetRef="Task_SetupAccounts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_SendOrientation" targetRef="Gateway_Onboard_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_SetupAccounts" targetRef="Gateway_Onboard_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Gateway_Onboard_Join" targetRef="Gateway_International_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intl" sourceRef="Gateway_International_Split" targetRef="Task_VisaProcessing">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${internationalStudent}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Domestic" sourceRef="Gateway_International_Split" targetRef="Gateway_International_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_VisaProcessing" targetRef="Gateway_International_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Gateway_International_Merge" targetRef="Task_IssueStudentID"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Task_IssueStudentID" targetRef="SubProcess_StudyPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="SubProcess_StudyPlan" targetRef="Gateway_Semester_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="Gateway_Semester_Merge" targetRef="Task_AttendClasses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_34" sourceRef="Task_AttendClasses" targetRef="Gateway_AddDrop_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddDrop" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDrop_Split" targetRef="Task_AddDropCourses">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${addDropChange}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAddDrop" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDrop_Split" targetRef="Gateway_AddDrop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="Task_AddDropCourses" targetRef="Gateway_AddDrop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_38" sourceRef="Gateway_AddDrop_Merge" targetRef="Task_PostGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_39" sourceRef="Task_PostGrades" targetRef="Task_ReviewGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_40" sourceRef="Task_ReviewGrades" targetRef="Gateway_Grievance_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Grievance" sourceRef="Gateway_Grievance_Split" targetRef="SubProcess_Appeal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${grievanceFiled}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGrievance" sourceRef="Gateway_Grievance_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Grievance_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_43" sourceRef="SubProcess_Appeal" targetRef="Gateway_Grievance_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_44" sourceRef="Gateway_Grievance_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Continue_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Graduated" sourceRef="Gateway_Continue_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_GraduatedOrWithdrawn">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${graduatedOrWithdrawn}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContinueSemester" sourceRef="Gateway_Continue_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Semester_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
